Welcome
The Cliff Hotel & Spa is a large family-owned hotel where a warm, friendly welcome, excellent facilities and the highest standards of service and cleanliness ensure that your stay is a most pleasant one.
At our 76 ensuite bedroom hotel, we offer first-rate facilities for those looking for a break, romantic get-away, special occasions, family holiday, business travellers, conference organisers, those getting married or looking for a place to eat and drink in comfort.
With expansive, beautiful hotel grounds, The Cliff Hotel & Spa is located on the coast of Cardigan Bay overlooking Poppit Sands and Cardigan Island. The perfect holiday destination to explore the West Wales’ beautiful Ceredigion and Pembrokeshire Coast. With excellent spa facilities you can unwind and enjoy the serenity that The Cliff Hotel & Spa provides all set in a breath-taking coastal location.
With Cardigan Golf Course nearby, and our very own 9-hole golf course, this is the perfect destination for golf-lovers looking to enjoy a round of golf or two, surrounded by the stunning scenery of Wales’ best coast, Ceredigion and Pembrokeshire.
We take pride in creating an escape for our guests, a place they can rely on to provide seamless service throughout. You don’t need to go anywhere else. Relax and unwind in an outside hot-tub overlooking the ocean. Wake-up to room service or a plentiful breakfast buffet in our sea-view restaurant. Play a round of golf taking in the fresh sea air or indulge in our underground spa with an array of nourishing treatments to choose from to restore calm and tranquillity. Enjoy the magnificent coastline with plenty of walks to immerse yourself in the spectacular Welsh coast and its wildlife.
Providing coastal luxury from start to finish it’s a breath-taking place to make romantic memories that last a lifetime, whether that is your engagement, hen/stag party, the wedding day itself or a return for your anniversary. Events play a major part in creating those ever-lasting memories set within an idyllic coastal vista. From dramatic stormy seas to still turquoise waters we provide the setting for dolphins playing through the waves, seals bobbing in the bay and geese flying over-head, creating a picturesque scene for any guest.

CLICK HERE FOR ACCOMMODATION OFFERS
At The Cliff Hotel & Spa we have 76 beautifully furnished ensuite bedrooms, decorated to compliment our picturesque marine location.
Many of our rooms enjoy views of the rugged Pembrokeshire coastline, balconies or even your own private hot tub! With 12 different room types to choose from, suiting a huge range of budgets, you’re sure to find the perfect escape. Included is 1 hour use of our Spa per night of your stay, featuring hot tub, sauna, steam room and hydrotherapy pool; pre-booking with our reservations department is advised.

ABOUT US
WHO WE ARE
The Flatrock Group is owned by Wells and Louise Jones, both local to Cardigan, who have built the Flatrock Group portfolio over several years, witnessing the business go from strength to strength. Their goal is to provide something for everyone, whether that’s a holiday destination in luxury coastal settings or comfortable yet affordable accommodation in convenient town locations. From restaurants and bars to self-contained coastal holiday cottages, the Group offer something for all occassions and budgets.
Every property within the Flatrock Group portfolio provides our clients with a place to relax and enjoy the West Wales coastal surroundings. We look forward to welcoming you to one of our properties soon.
The Cliff Hotel & Spa
The Harbourmaster
The Gwbert Hotel and Flat Rock Bar & Restaurant
Gwbert Holidays
The Black Lion
The Grosvenor
The Angel Hotel
A CAREER WITH FLATROCK GROUP
Comprising of 7 hospitality businesses located in or near Cardigan. We are seeking enthusiastic, team players to work with us as an ever-expanding hospitality business group. From housekeeping to chefs and even managerial roles we look forward to expanding our team.
Visit our ‘Careers’ Page today
CAREERS
OUR PROPERTIES
The Cliff Hotel & Spa boasts 76 ensuite bedrooms, and we offer first-rate facilities for those looking for a break, a romantic get-away, special occasions, family holidays, business travellers, conference organisers, those getting married or looking for a place to eat and drink in comfort.
We’re a venue with everything under one roof. Our underground Cliff Spa offers a serene escape to relax and unwind, and our expert therapists are on hand to help take all your stresses away with a range of indulgent treatments. Our onsite 9-hole golf course provides the rest and relaxation you re looking for, surrounded by stunning views. Our Carreg Restaurant offers indulgent dinners, delicious lunches and decadent afternoon teas, providing something for everyone. And if it s a space to relax and reconnect that you re looking for, our Point Bar is the perfect spot. Enjoy panoramic coastal views with a coffee and a cake, or perhaps a cocktail or glass of fizz.
As a retreat in the heart of Wales overlooking the Ceredigion coastline, we re spoiled with stunning coastal views, making it an idyllic spot for taking a stroll along clifftops or wandering down to hidden coves. Providing coastal luxury from start to finish, The Cliff Hotel and Spa is a breath-taking venue to make memories that last a lifetime.
A Brief History
Originally developed from The Gwbert Inn, built by local businessman Morgan Richardson around 1889 this impressive building stands proudly on the cliffs overlooking the idyllic Pembrokeshire heritage coastline. Richardson wanted to create the seaside resort of Gwbert to challenge both Brighton and Scarborough. With its clifftop golf course and spectacular position, it quickly became not only the most impressive hotel in the area, but nationally renowned. The Cliff Hotel & Spa lives up to The Gwbert’s promise, retaining its position today as one of the most luxurious hotels and romantic getaways in the area, attracting visitors from UK, Europe and America.
Purchased in 2014 by Wells and Louise Jones, The Cliff Hotel & Spa has gone from strength to strength in a short amount of time. At the time of purchase, the hotel was dated and in need of structural improvements. Not only have the couple turned this around, but they have also grown a team of 40 staff members to well over 140. They are both dedicated to honouring the hotel as a place for both the community of Ceredigion and a holiday destination for all. Personal touches can be seen throughout the hotel, making the vast building feel warm and welcoming. Light and airy halls are filled with local coastal art and products to purchase, all supporting the community and local artists.
Our team at The Cliff Hotel & Spa work tirelessly to provide quality service with a personal approach and look forward to welcoming you soon.
The Harbourmaster sits proudly within the Flatrock collection. Offering luxury accommodation, serving locally sourced produce in the contemporary bar and restaurant and featuring dramatic sea views in its prime harbour location of Aberaeron, there s no wonder The Harbourmaster has received so many accolades over the years for its hospitality, food and wine.
Built in 1811 as the home and office for the town s harbourmaster, this iconic blue building has become synonymous with the town. A great sense of place with cool design and a warm Welsh welcome, the Harbourmaster is a great base
